verdicts.human_summary: Don't change the withToolbar condition because onReloadStory is virtually always present, making it impossible for users to disable the toolbar via withToolbar: false.
verdicts.reasoning: AI Comment 0 raises the identical concern: onReloadStory is unconditionally set for every inline story, so the `withToolbar || !!onReloadStory` condition in Preview.tsx always evaluates to true, silently overriding an explicit `withToolbar: false`. Both the human and AI comment identify the same root issue — users cannot opt out of the toolbar — even though the AI comment is anchored at Canvas.tsx:99 (where onReloadStory is unconditionally assigned) rather than Preview.tsx:194 (where the condition is evaluated).
